title: Skin Care for Ranchi Weather: A Routine for Bright Summers, Long Monsoons and Cold Dry Winters
ex: Bright plateau sun, a long wet monsoon and cold, dry winter nights: a simple, season-by-season skin care routine for people living in Ranchi.
rt: Skin Care for Ranchi Weather by Season | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Ranchi weather: sun care for bright summers, light layers in the long monsoon and a richer night routine for cold, dry plateau winters.
quick: Ranchi has a hot, bright summer from about March to May, a long wet monsoon from June to September and a cool, dry winter with cold nights from November to February. Keep a gentle face wash and broad-spectrum sunscreen all year, use light layers in the rains and a fuller night cream in winter.
facts: Ranchi sits on the Chota Nagpur plateau, higher than the Gangetic plains
Summer afternoons can bring sudden thunderstorms
The monsoon runs roughly June to September
Winter nights get cold while days stay sunny and dry
